title: scrophularia canina var. pinnatifida
intro: Scrophularia canina var. pinnatifida, commonly known as Alpine Figwort or Alpine Scrophularia, is a perennial herb belonging to the Figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Scrophularia canina var. pinnatifida include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
